scope: Disposable epoch and pause credit design; exact snapshot, checkpoint, suffix and reconnect SQL with minimal empty dependent tables

evidence.case: Four Maintenance Helpers Execute Exact Captured Bodies
Snapshot Binds Exact Epoch Before Broad Credit
Broad Credit And Add-On Resume Count Their Union Once
Incremental Future Target Rebase Subtracts Only Actual Credited Suffix
Two Maintenance Windows In One Epoch Never Double Count Local Pause
Overlapping Add-On And Synchronized Owners Receive Union Credit
Synchronized Snapshot Exclusion Is Proved By Actual Snapshot And Checkpoint
Pause Resume Refuses Before A Partial Thaw Is Final
Lost Resume Response Replays Without Adding Credit
Delayed Old Maintenance Retry Resolves And Cannot Extend A Closed Window
Old Epoch Maintenance Cannot Credit A New Level
Old Epoch Local Pause Cannot Credit A New Level
Adoption Preserves Existing Durable Pause Start
Pause Beginning Before Epoch Receives Only Epoch Overlap
Earlier Pause Receipt Replays After Another Owner Was Credited
Actual Broad Helper Failure Rolls Back Snapshot Binding And All Credit
Concurrent Pause Retry Rechecks The Durable Owner After Its Lock Wait

limitations: Five-argument outer ownership, admission freeze, future release hold and current production triggers are not executed
Timestamp inputs and audit write witnesses are test controls, not production APIs
Epoch and target binding ACLs, manager lifecycle, actual adoption and native paid/settlement composition remain unimplemented
Partial completion modeled by withholding fixture finalization, not by forcing a real four-second checkpoint budget
